From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Trial kickoff & prompt-set prep — next step alignment

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for the time earlier — great to hear more about how Optima Vitals wants to use retrieval-augmented generation for triage summaries and clinician note drafting. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary success metric: 30% reduction in clinician triage time for inbound messages (target within 6 weeks of trial).
- Data available: de-identified CSV of triage messages + canonical diagnosis codes; sample size ~10k rows.
- Constraints: PHI must remain in your VPC; prefer Private deployment or dedicated tenant for the evaluation.

Next steps I promised: schedule an evaluation kickoff (technical deep-dive + trial plan share), align on prompt set and evaluation prompts, and confirm environment & data access. Would any of these windows work for a 60-min kickoff next week?
- Tue 5/4 15:00–16:00 ET
- Wed 5/5 11:00–12:00 ET
- Thu 5/6 09:00–10:00 ET

If you prefer a different time just send a few options and we’ll accommodate. I’ve attached a first draft trial plan and a small sample prompt set to show the kind of evals we run.

Attachments: [Redwood-trial-plan-v1.pdf (pdf, 320 KB)], [prompt-set-sample.csv (csv, 12 KB)]

Also: Marcus (serving/runtime) and Neha (solutions) are cc’d and will join the kickoff for the architecture and prompt-eval sections.

Goal for the kickoff: lock the trial scope (targets, datasets, timeline), agree on who needs access, and confirm the calendar invite + owners for prompt set handoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the draft plan. We’re keen to proceed. Wed 5/5 11:00–12:00 ET works best for our team. Please lock that slot if it’s still available.

A couple of items for the kickoff agenda we’d like to cover up front:
- Data ingestion approach (S3 vs direct DB extracts) and estimated time to first run.
- Isolation model: prefer Redwood Private in our VPC; need to confirm KMS/HSM integration.
- Success criteria: we’ll validate with clinicians but initial internal targets are 30% triage time reduction + F1 > 0.78 on entity extraction across the sample set.
- Prompt handoff: we will bring two clinical SMEs plus a product manager — I will share a short prompt list before the call.

I’ve looped in Tom (ops lead) — he will share the data extraction owner and any procurement hurdles.

Replying inline: Wed 5/5 11:00 ET = confirmed for Optima Vitals.

—Alice
